sources.qualification: Official page reports a limited promotional rate through 2026-10-08, then $0.048/image. Not bound as a production route or quote.
Official page publishes per-second billing; exact billed returned duration, output properties and production authorization remain unresolved.

Official schema exposes image_url, prompt, negative_prompt, aspect_ratio, resolution, cfg_scale, guidance_scale, num_frames and safety checker; it does not establish a guaranteed output frame rate/container/codec for this production plan.

scenarioOnly.assumption: 43 image submissions (8 generated final stills + 23 animation dependency stills + 12 dedicated references) at the Flux 3 listed rate, plus 23 five-second Framepack clips at the listed rate; exactly one successful submission per output, no failed/charged attempts, no retries, no storage or tax.

productionPrices: UNRESOLVED: the package has no approved production endpoint/model selection, and listed route prices do not fix production terms, ownership, billed output duration or failure billing.
retryFailoverExposure: Not authorized. Without provider-enforced caps, any additional submission could increase cost; detached per-request approvals and reservation checks are required.
